title: Digital benchmarking tools for assessment in maritime English training
reason: Single-group pre/post comparison of maritime English test levels after digital benchmarking tools in Moodle. Moodle activity growth is described only narratively; no per-student indicator is related to an outcome. No n or statistics reported.

extraction.population: cadets (future ship engineers), 1 maritime higher-education institution
extraction.lms_indicators: Moodle login frequency and task completion described descriptively at group level only
extraction.outcome_or_construct: English proficiency pre/post test; questionnaire motivation
extraction.notes: "The participants were not divided into control and experimental groups"; results only in bar charts (Fig. 1, Fig. 2) with no test statistics. Bilingual English/Ukrainian article. Secondary code: NOREL (Moodle activity data reported only narratively).
